result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add new tests, so the new matches themselves (a `.htm` page, `MyAssembly.xml`, `build-gradle.js`) aren't exercised.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)` listed `html` twice and never `htm`. It is now `.*[.](html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the path patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` required a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` match.
- **Gradle JS script:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `.*[.]gradle` is unchanged.

The content patterns are unchanged. They are matched against whole lines, so a hand-written `.htm`, `.js` or `.xml` file stays out of these scopes unless it contains the generated marker. The `<doc>` pattern also only matches a line that is exactly `<doc>`, so an indented `<doc>` line wouldn't match, as before.
